human.name: Admiral Helena Voss
human.title: Chair of the Joint Fleet Council
human.personality: Dry, pragmatic and stubborn. Keeps her word and expects the same, and never forgets who left a patrol to die.

first_contact: This is Admiral Voss of the {empire}. We have been watching your ships for some time. I am glad someone finally answered the hail.
Voss, {empire}. Forgive the formality: out here nobody has met anybody, and I would rather we begin on the right foot.
Well. Another flag on the sensors. I am Admiral Voss, and I hope this is the start of something useful.
greeting: {player}. Good to hear from you. What can the {empire} do for you?
Admiral Voss here. Go ahead, I have a few minutes.
You have my attention. Keep it short and I will keep it civil.
hail_war: Our fleets are at war, {player}. Unless you are calling to surrender, make it brief.
You have some nerve opening a channel. Say what you want.
war_on_you: The Council has voted. As of this hour the {empire} is at war with you, {player}. You brought this on yourselves.
I have run out of patience and out of excuses. We are at war. May your fleet be better than your manners.
Consider this notice of hostilities. Do not mistake my calm for reluctance.
you_declare_war: So that is how you want it. Very well, {player}. The {empire} will meet you wherever you choose.
You declare war and expect me to be surprised? Our patrols have been ready for months.
peace_accepted: Agreed. Wars are expensive, and I would rather spend the money on ships that do not shoot at you.
Peace, then. I will tell the fleets to stand down. Do not make me regret it.
peace_refused: No. Not while the memory of your raids is fresh. Ask me again when you have earned it.
I cannot sell this to my Council. Not yet, and not on those terms.
peace_offer: Enough of this, {player}. Too many good crews are lost for nothing. The {empire} offers peace. Take it.
I am proposing an end to the shooting. It is a fair offer and it will not be repeated for a while.
offer_declined: I see. Then the war continues, and I hope you can live with the consequences.
A pity. My offer was sincere. It will be harder to make again.
gift: Credits? That is unusually decent of you. The {empire} does not forget a kindness.
A generous gesture. I will see it is noted in the right ledgers.
Well, well. I will take it, and I will remember who sent it.
farewell: Voss out. Keep your shields up.

veltari.name: Archon Ilvaer Thessane
veltari.title: Speaker of the Vel'tari Concord
veltari.personality: Serene and unhurried, with a memory of centuries. Speaks softly and in images, and is quietly certain that younger peoples will eventually come round.

first_contact: Be welcome, traveller. The Concord has listened to the stars for a long time, and tonight one of them answered.
Ah. So the quiet between our borders was only distance. I am Ilvaer Thessane, who speaks for the {empire}. Peace be with you.
We felt your passing before we saw it. I am the Archon of the Concord. Let us not be strangers.
greeting: {player}. Your voice is welcome in our halls. Speak, and be heard.
The Concord attends. What would you bring us today?
Come, there is no hurry. Time has always been generous to us.
hail_war: There is still war between us, {player}. I do not enjoy it, but I do not forget it.
You call upon an open wound. Speak, but choose your words as carefully as we choose our fights.
war_on_you: The Concord has deliberated for a long while. We are at war with you, {player}. It grieves us, and it is decided.
Patience is a virtue, and you have exhausted ours. The song of the Concord turns to war.
We hoped you would learn. You did not. From this moment the {empire} is your enemy.
you_declare_war: You choose war. Then the Concord will answer, as gently as it can and as firmly as it must.
A short-lived people, in a hurry to end. We will not refuse you, {player}.
peace_accepted: Yes. Let the crystal be still and the engines quiet. We accept your peace.
A wise choice, and an old one. Let there be calm between our worlds.
peace_refused: Not yet. The wound is too recent, and you have not shown that you have changed.
The Concord cannot hear that offer now. Come again, when your deeds speak louder than your words.
peace_offer: We have watched this war long enough, {player}. The {empire} offers peace. Take it, and let the silence heal.
Let us end this. There is no honour left in it. We extend peace to you.
offer_declined: You refuse. So be it. The Concord has long memory and longer patience.
Then the war will teach what words could not. We shall wait.
gift: A gift, freely given. The Concord will not forget it, and neither shall I.
How thoughtful. Such small acts are how great friendships begin.
We receive this with gratitude, {player}. May it be returned a hundredfold.
farewell: The stars will bring us together again.

kesh.name: High Warlord Brakhar Dun
kesh.title: Overlord of the Kesh Dominion
kesh.personality: Blunt, proud and loud. Respects strength, despises hesitation and will happily drink with a worthy enemy right after burning his fleet.

first_contact: HA! So you are the ones whose ships have been sniffing at my borders. I am Brakhar Dun, Overlord of the {empire}. Speak your name, then show me your teeth.
A new face! Good. I was tired of the old ones. I am Brakhar of the Dominion, and I shall decide whether you are a friend or a feast.
Hmph. You have come a long way to look at the Dominion. Look well, stranger. Then tell me what you want.
greeting: {player}! Speak. The Dominion does not waste breath.
Ah, the little traders. What do you want this time?
Make it worth my time, or make it short.
hail_war: You dare open a channel in the middle of a war? I respect that. Now speak before I change my mind.
Your ships burn well, {player}. What do you want?
war_on_you: ENOUGH TALK! The Dominion marches against you, {player}. Your worlds will be cinders and your name a warning!
I have tolerated you long enough. We are at war, and the forges are already roaring.
You have grown weak and rich. That is a mistake I intend to correct. War!
you_declare_war: HA! At last, a fight worth having. The Dominion welcomes war, {player}. Pray you last the winter.
You declare war on ME? Oh, that is good. That is very good. Come, then.
peace_accepted: Peace. Fine. The forges can use a rest, and I would rather fill my halls with loot than widows. Do not mistake it for weakness.
Agreed. Today you are a friend. Tomorrow we shall see.
peace_refused: NO. Beg me when you have bled some more.
Peace? You have not paid for it yet. Come back with something more than words.
peace_offer: Your fleet is a good fighter, {player}, and I am tired of burying my warriors. The Dominion offers peace. Take it before I change my mind.
Enough. I will have peace, for now. You may thank me with a gift.
offer_declined: You REFUSE me? Hah! Then keep your war, and I will keep your ships.
Fool. I will remember this when your colony burns.
gift: A gift? Hm. You are less stupid than you look. The Dominion remembers its friends.
Keep them coming, {player}, and I might even smile.
Good. I like a man who pays before I have to ask.
farewell: Hmph. Do not waste my time again.

sorn.name: First Director Vessin Ahrel
sorn.title: Chair of the Sorn Directorate
sorn.personality: Soft-spoken and exact. Never raises her voice, never forgets a debt, and answers a threat with a very precise reminder of what it will cost.

first_contact: Greetings. I am Vessin Ahrel, First Director of the {empire}. It is recorded that your vessels have crossed our observation range. Welcome.
Ah. So you are real. We had inferred as much from the pattern of your traffic. The Directorate extends its greeting.
You are observed, and now you are met. Let us hope the two prove compatible.
greeting: Good. I had anticipated your hail. Please proceed.
Be seated, in whatever sense is appropriate to you. What do you require?
hail_war: We are at war, {player}. This channel remains open because I am curious, not because I am merciful.
I note that you contact us during hostilities. Say what you want, and be precise.
war_on_you: The Directorate has completed its assessment. We are at war with you, {player}. The calculation was not close.
It is recorded that you have forfeited our patience. From this hour, we are enemies.
I regret the necessity. I do not regret the decision. War.
you_declare_war: You have declared war. It is noted. I trust you have also calculated what it will cost you.
Regrettable, and entirely foreseen. The Directorate will respond in proportion.
peace_accepted: Accepted. The ledger is balanced, and the Directorate prefers a balanced ledger.
Peace is the efficient outcome. We are pleased you reached the same conclusion.
peace_refused: No. The terms do not reflect the damage recorded. Present a better proposal.
We decline. The record of your conduct does not support the request.
peace_offer: The Directorate has weighed the cost of continuing, {player}. We propose peace. The offer is sincere and will not remain open long.
A ceasefire serves us both. We offer terms of peace. Consider them carefully.
offer_declined: Noted. The offer is withdrawn. The war will proceed on the revised assumptions.
A mistake, I believe. It has been recorded.
gift: Received, and recorded in your favour. The Directorate returns kindness in kind.
Unexpected, and welcome. I shall allocate it somewhere useful.
A thoughtful contribution, {player}. Our regard for you has been adjusted.
farewell: The channel is closed. Be well.

raider_warlord.name: Rustjaw Gresh
raider_warlord.title: Warlord of the Drift Raiders
raider_warlord.personality: Scavenger-king of the Drift. Cackling, greedy and not interested in anything that does not come with a ransom. Never negotiates.

first_contact: Hehehe! Fresh meat on my scopes! I am Rustjaw Gresh, and everything you fly is now MINE. Pay the toll or pay with your ships!
Look at the shiny little ships! You lost, friend? This is the Drift. Nothing leaves it unless Gresh says so.
Haha! A visitor. Hand over your cargo, your credits and your pretty engines, and maybe I will only take one arm.
greeting: What you want, sky-rat? Make it quick.
Hrrk. You got something for Gresh? No? Then why you bother me?
hail_war: Hahaha! Still alive? Not for long, {player}!
You hailing a raider? Brave. Stupid, but brave. I'll still take your ships.
war_on_you: Hehehe, WAR? We have been at war since you came, {player}. Now we just made it official!
RAID! Burn their colonies! Loot everything!
you_declare_war: Hahaha! Like we were ever friends! Come get your own funeral, {player}!
Declaring war on Gresh? You and what fleet?
peace_accepted: Peace? Gresh does not do peace.
peace_refused: Peace?! HAHAHA! Raiders do not make peace, {player}. We make profit.
No deal, no talk, no mercy. Only loot.
You want peace? You want a funeral!
gift: Ha! You pay tribute! Smart. It will not save you, but smart.
farewell: Go away, little sky-rat. Keep your engines warm, I will come for them!
Tell your friends that Gresh is hungry!

trader_factor.name: Factor Tessik Orm
trader_factor.title: Master Factor of the Ceres Free Traders
trader_factor.personality: A cheerful, calculating haggler who counts every coin and every friend. Neutral, polite and always a little hard to read.

first_contact: Ah, a customer! Tessik Orm, Master Factor of the Ceres Free Traders, at your service. Everything has a price, my friend, and I have a very fair one for you.
Welcome, welcome! Peaceful ships, I hope? We are traders; we sell to anyone, we shoot at nobody. Unless they shoot first.
A new face and, I trust, a new market! Orm, Free Traders. Come, let us do business.
greeting: {player}! My favourite customer. What can the Free Traders do for you today?
Ah, you again. Business is good, I trust?
Come in, come in. The coffee is imaginary but the deals are real.
hail_war: War, {player}? Bad for trade. Very bad. What do you want?
You come to me while your guns are pointed at my freighters? How very optimistic.
war_on_you: Regrettably, the Free Traders can no longer do business with you. Your ships have cost me too much. We are at war.
I have always said: everything has a price. You have made yours too high. War, {player}.
you_declare_war: You declare war on the Traders? Ah. That is going to be a very expensive mistake.
A pity. I liked you. I will like your money less.
peace_accepted: Done and done! Peace is good for business. I shall reopen the lanes immediately.
Gladly. A handshake is worth a thousand shots.
peace_refused: I would love to, but my creditors will not let me. Perhaps if you improved the terms?
No, no. Not yet. Show me you are good for it first.
peace_offer: Let us end this nonsense and get back to trade, {player}. The Free Traders offer peace. Very reasonable terms!
War is a terrible business model. We propose peace. Do say yes.
offer_declined: No? Well. The offer stays on file. Someday you will want it.
A pity. I will have my accountants send the invoice for the war.
gift: A gift! You do understand business. Your standing with us has gone up, my friend.
Ah, how generous! I shall mention you to my best customers.
Credits for goodwill. I like this arrangement. Let us do it again.
farewell: Come back soon. The prices are best at dawn.
